reviews.title: Great RAM, top notch quality.
reviews.comment: Needed memory for my new AMD 9800X3D builds and this seemed to have the perfect mix of price and performance. Upon arrive I noted the amazing quality of the packaging. Opening it up I was very impressed with the feel of the heat spreaders and design. Installed it is very tall and I had to setup my air cooler in a pull/pull to make room. Once my new builds were finished I was very happy with the performance from this memory. Good stuff for sure...
reviews.author: K McC

reviews.comment: Works great and looks even better.. always used  Corsair or gskill until I found this.. highly recommend..

reviews.title: Biwin Ram
reviews.comment:
I didn't want to go with a company that I hadn't heard of before. I have heard of Acer. It turns out these are made by a company called Biwin, and licensed by Acer to use their trademark name. This is stated on the product packaging.
There is also "Biwin" brand RAM for sale on Amazon which appears to be identical for $40 less at time of writing.
It seems to operate as expected at the advertised speed.
reviews.author: Fuzz

reviews.title: Amazing performance and looks fantastic
reviews.comment: Great looking ram and runs at advertised speeds. Compatibility with my MSI motherboard was not an issue and installation was a breeze. I highly recommend this ddr5 kit.
